title: Verify public status endpoint returns app status
preconditions: The app needs to be running
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/public/status
expected_result:
Response status is 200 and response body includes app metadata:
app_name is SuperSQA Job Tracker
api_version is v1
environment is local
server_time is present

title: Verify public demo stats endpoint returns demo statistics
preconditions: The app needs to be running
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/public/demo-stats
expected_result:
Response status is 200 and response body includes:
total_seeded_applications as an integer
status_counts as an object
each status count value as an integer

title: Verify user can login with valid credentials
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the test user needs to exist
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body includes access_token, token_type bearer, expires_in, and a populated user object for the login email

title: Verify user cannot login with invalid credentials
preconditions: The app needs to be running
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with a valid email and invalid password
expected_result: Response status is 401 and response body includes error code INVALID_CREDENTIALS, message Invalid email or password, and an empty details list

title: Verify authenticated user can get applications
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/applications
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body is a non-empty list of applications

title: Verify authenticated user can get applications summary
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/applications/summary
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body includes integer counts for potential, applied, in_progress, final_stage, hired, rejected, withdrawn, and total

title: Verify user can create application
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/applications with a valid application payload
expected_result: Response status is 201 and response body matches the submitted application fields. A follow-up GET by id returns the same created application

title: Verify user can update application status
preconditions: The app needs to be running and a test application needs to exist
steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/v1/applications/{application_id} changing status from applied to in_progress
expected_result: Response status is 200 and response body shows the updated status. A follow-up GET by id returns the saved status

title: Verify user can delete application
preconditions: The app needs to be running and a test application needs to exist
steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/v1/applications/{application_id} and then send a GET request for the same id
expected_result: Delete response status is 204. Follow-up GET for the deleted application returns 404

title: Verify user can update application notes
preconditions: The app needs to be running and a test application needs to exist
steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/v1/applications/{application_id} with a new notes value
expected_result: Response status is 200 and notes value is changed. A follow-up GET by id returns the updated notes

title: Verify user can update application remote type
preconditions: The app needs to be running and a test application needs to exist with remote_type on_site
steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/v1/applications/{application_id} changing remote_type to hybrid
expected_result: Response status is 200 and remote_type changes from on_site to hybrid. A follow-up GET by id returns hybrid

title: Verify user can update application salary range
preconditions: The app needs to be running and a test application needs to exist
steps: Send a PATCH request to /api/v1/applications/{application_id} with a new salary_range value
expected_result: Response status is 200 and salary_range is changed. A follow-up GET by id returns the updated salary_range

title: Verify create application requires company name
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/applications without company_name
expected_result: Response status is 422 and response body includes error code VALIDATION_ERROR, message Request validation failed, and validation details for company_name

title: Verify create application rejects invalid status
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/applications with an invalid status value
expected_result: Response status is 422 and response body includes error code VALIDATION_ERROR, message Request validation failed, and validation details for status

title: Verify nonexistent application returns not found
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client needs to be authenticated
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/applications/999999
expected_result: Response status is 404 and response body includes error code NOT_FOUND, message Application not found, and an empty details list

title: Verify applications list requires authentication
preconditions: The app needs to be running and the API client must not be authenticated
steps: Send a GET request to /api/v1/applications without authentication
expected_result: Response status is 401 and response body includes error code AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED and message Authentication required

title: Verify creating an application writes an audit log using raw SQL
preconditions: The app needs to be running and database access needs to be available
steps: Create an application through POST /api/v1/applications and query application_audit_logs directly with sqlite3
expected_result: Application is created with status 201 and the database contains an audit log row for the application with action created and a user_id

title: Verify creating an application writes an audit log using SQLClient
preconditions: The app needs to be running and database access needs to be available
steps: Create an application through POST /api/v1/applications and query application_audit_logs using SQLClient
expected_result: Application is created with status 201 and the database contains an audit log row for the application with action created and a user_id

title: Verify updating an application writes an audit log
preconditions: The app needs to be running and database access needs to be available
steps: Create an application with status potential and then PATCH the application status to applied
expected_result: Response status is successful and the latest audit log row has action updated, old_status potential, and new_status applied

title: Verify deleting an application writes an audit log
preconditions: The app needs to be running and database access needs to be available
steps: Create an application with status potential and then DELETE the application
expected_result: Delete response status is 204, follow-up GET returns 404, and the latest audit log row has action deleted, old_status potential, and new_status empty

title: Verify API key is not stored as plain text
preconditions: The app needs to be running and database access needs to be available
steps: Send a POST request to /api/v1/api-keys and then query the api_keys table for the created key
expected_result: Response includes an api_key and key_prefix starting with jt_live_. The database key_prefix matches the response and hashed_key is not equal to the plain text api_key
